subject: PO code assignment for Aurelia Systems onboarding — spend cap and line-item correction
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aurelia-sys.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@aurelia-sys.com
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding paperwork + PO code request

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier today. We're ready to move forward with Redwood and need a formal PO number to share with our accounts payable. Two quick asks so we can complete our internal onboarding:

- Can you provide a purchase order / PO code we can reference for the initial committed spend?
- Confirm the spend cap you have in your onboarding checklist (we typically gate payments to a quarterly cap). If you have a different format, we'll adapt.

I've attached our signed onboarding form (filled) and the draft SOW for your intake. We'll need the PO reflected with the following line items per the SOW:
  - Product subscription (annual, prorated) — $45,000
  - Implementation & onboarding services — $30,000

Total first-year billing: $75,000

Please copy procurement@aurelia-sys.com on the PO issuance. We need the PO by next Tuesday (12/2) to avoid delaying the onboarding kickoff.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Finance Operations
Aurelia Systems

[Attachment: Aurelia_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aurelia-sys.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding paperwork + PO code request

Hi Lena — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the attached SOW.

We can absolutely provide a PO code. Provisional details below:

- PO code: PO-2025-4421 (provisional, final PDF attached)
- Issued spend ceiling (internal): $75,000 total first year
- Quarterly spend cap (what we set internally for charge control): $50,000 per quarter

Note: When our procurement team created the PO it was mapped to a single "Onboarding & Services" line item for internal routing. I see how that will complicate your AP reconciliation since your SOW separates subscription vs. services.

Action items:
- Neha (cc) — can you reissue the PO with two line items to match Aurelia's SOW (subscription vs implementation) and update the spend cap labels so Aurelia's AP sees the quarterly cap?
- Lena — can you confirm whether you want the total cap enforced at $75k/year or a hard quarterly cap of $50k (we can stamp either; your note suggested $50k/quarter but the SOW math looked like $75k total).

Attaching the provisional PO PDF for reference. Once Neha confirms the corrected line-item PO, we'll upload the signed copy and notify procurement@aurelia-sys.com.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps coordinate.

Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

[Attachment: PO_2025-11-29_AURELIA.pdf (PDF, 58KB)]

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aurelia-sys.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@aurelia-sys.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 08:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding paperwork + PO code request

Thanks Diego — quick clarification: we did receive PO-2025-4421, but AP flagged that the PO shows a single "Professional Services - Onboarding" line with $60,000 and no separate subscription line. Our SOW and internal ledger require two discrete lines so payments map correctly:
  1) Product subscription (annual) — $45,000
  2) Implementation services (one-time) — $30,000

Also, please can you change the explicitly stated payment ceiling to a firm quarterly cap of $50,000? The current single-line PO and $60k services value will mis-route invoices and delay payment.

I've attached an updated SOW excerpt and highlighted the line-item breakdown for your procurement team. If you reissue the PO with separate lines and set the spend control to $50k/quarter (and $75k total), we can proceed with the kickoff.

Lena

On Fri, Nov 28, 2025 at 11:03 AM diego_fernandez@redwood.com wrote:
> We can absolutely provide a PO code. Provisional details below:
> - PO code: PO-2025-4421 (provisional, final PDF attached)
> - Issued spend ceiling (internal): $75,000 total first year
> - Quarterly spend cap (what we set internally for charge control): $50,000 per quarter
>
> Note: When our procurement team created the PO it was mapped to a single "Onboarding & Services" line item for internal routing. I see how that will complicate your AP reconciliation since your SOW separates subscription vs. services.

[Attachment: Aurelia_SOW_excerpt_for_PO.xlsx (XLSX, 65KB)]

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aurelia-sys.com>, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, procurement@aurelia-sys.com
Date: Mon, 30 Dec 2025 16:24:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Onboarding paperwork + PO code request — revised PO and spend controls

Hi all — looping in finance/procurement follow-up. Apologies for the delay; we wanted to confirm the correct mapping before reissuing.

Confirmed updates we will make:
- Reissue PO-2025-4421 as PO-2025-4421-R1 with two line items to match Aurelia's SOW:
    * Line 1: Product subscription (annual, prorated) — $45,000
    * Line 2: Implementation & onboarding services (one-time) — $30,000
- Set enforcement labels to: Quarterly spend cap = $50,000, Annual total cap = $75,000
- Upload revised signed PO to Drive and e-mail procurement@aurelia-sys.com the PDF + our internal invoice routing code.
- Reference: PROC ticket PROC-452 for audit trail.

Next steps: I will upload PO-2025-4421-R1 to the shared drive by EOD and reply-all with the link. Diego — can you confirm whether Aurelia requires Redwood's finance contact on the PO (we'll include karthik_iyer@redwood.com if you want direct payments routed)?

Thanks — we'll mark this closed once the signed PDF is posted.

—Neha Kapoor
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0147

[Attachment: po_lineitems_correction_20251130.csv (CSV, 4KB)]
